evidence.curator_note: Middle horizontal arrow of Equation 8.82, labelled 'a, -R.': the alkoxy-radical / protonated-ester ion made in Equation 8.82a undergoes a textbook radical-site alpha cleavage at the carbinol carbon, expelling R. and forming the aldehyde C(7)=O(9); the charge stays on the protonated methoxy oxygen O(11), which is untouched. Book draws 2 arc(s) for this branch, both single-barb fishhooks and both SOLID: (i) from the radical dot on O(9) curving down into the C(7)-O(9) bond (encoded as move <1>) and (ii) from the R-C(7) bond curving up into the same C(7)-O(9) bond (move <2>). Move <3>, the second homolysis hook that puts the other C(7)-R electron on the departing radical R., is an implicit hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). NOTE ON THE SAME PANEL: a third, DASHED fishhook is printed there, running from the C(7)-(CH2)n bond into the C(7)-O(9) bond; it does NOT belong to this step but to the competing 'a, -RCHO' branch drawn downwards from the same panel (record IMS8-EQ8.82e), which is why the book dashes it. INSTANTIATION (the scheme is generic in R and in the chain length n): R = CH3 and n = 5, i.e. methyl 7-hydroxyoctanoate CH3-CH(OH)-(CH2)5-C(=O)-OCH3 (C9H18O3, M+. m/z 174.1250). n = 5 is the smallest chain that makes the final 'rH, a' step of this same scheme proceed through the favoured six-membered transition state, and it keeps the book's (CH2)n-3 label meaningful ((CH2)2). NO m/z and NO percentage is printed anywhere in Equation 8.82 except 'm/z 55' on the last product; every other mass in these records is the curator's computed monoisotopic value for this instantiation, not a measured number.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.82 (the index stops at 8.14 for Chapter 8), so no MOD rule is cross-linked to this record. IMS_4_9 (the generic 'radical induced (alpha-)cleavage for a saturated site') was checked against this step and does NOT match: its DFS '[C]1[C]2[C]3([C]4)[_A+.]5>>[C.]1.[C]2[C]3([C]4){=}[_A+.]5' breaks the C1-C2 bond, which is NOT incident to C3, the atom that forms the new pi bond with the radical site, and its product keeps an unpaired electron on [_A+.]5 in addition to the new double bond (spin non-conservation). It also requires the radical site to be the charge site, whereas here the odd electron sits on a NEUTRAL alkoxy oxygen while the charge sits on a remote oxonium. IMS_4_13_1 is the concrete version of the same reaction for a charged ether oxygen and is inapplicable for the same reason. Unmodelled.
